response.sql: WITH rating_inventory AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), stats AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_inventory), above_avg AS (SELECT ri.copy_count, s.avg_count FROM rating_inventory ri CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ri.copy_count > s.avg_count) SELECT SUM(copy_count) AS total_copies, AVG(copy_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM above_avg
